isf-flip-v._look: Turns the picture upside down, with the sky at the bottom and reflections on top; a static, disorienting inversion.

isf-flipbook._look: Flipbook: several times a second a fresh grab of the picture slides down, squashed, over the last one, leaving a constantly rolling page-flip seam.

isf-frosted-glass._look: Frosted glass: every pixel is scattered in a fixed random grain, so the picture is seen softly through a textured pane; static.

isf-ghosting._look: Lens ghosting: the brightest areas are thresholded and added back as offset copies, blowing highlights out into a hot glowing bloom; static.

isf-glitch-shifter._look: Random horizontal bands and blocks of the picture jump sideways and wrap around, re-rolled every frame: jittery digital tearing over the image.

isf-glow._look: A static gloom-and-bloom treatment: the picture is blurred into itself and its contrast pushed hard, so highlights blow out to white neon and shadows crush to black.

isf-glow-fast._look: The same gloom, contrast push and bloom as Glow with a cheaper blur: blown white neon highlights, saturated colour, shadows crushed to black. No motion of its own.

isf-gn-broke-in-bad._look: Bright areas break into thin rows that jitter sideways every frame under a fine white pixel grain, like TV static over the highlights. Shadows stay clean.

isf-gn-brutalist-crush._look: XOR bit-crush chained with pixel sorting: the picture collapses into posterised pink, yellow and olive blocks, smeared sort columns and dark vertical streaks. The subject is barely legible.

isf-gn-datamosh._look: Fake datamosh: around edges the picture breaks into macroblocks that smear and hang on from earlier frames, with chroma bleeding like a corrupted video stream.

isf-gn-edge-turbulence._look: Feedback trails: bright areas and edges leave soft, hue-shifting halos that zoom slowly outward with noise turbulence, screen-blended over the picture as a glowing haze.

isf-gn-flow-map-1-0-0._look: Pixel flow held back at edges, with chroma fringes: the picture darkens into wavy, rainbow-fringed contour lines and streaks, like an oil-slick thermal scan.

isf-gn-glitch-flow-map._look: Pixel-sort smears in the mid-tones: the hull and ice pick up iridescent rainbow fringes and short trailing streaks, while the rest of the picture stays intact.

isf-gn-modulation-synth._look: Analog video-synth: the whole picture turns into rainbow frequency-modulated stripes that bend around its shapes. The subject survives only as a pale, smeared silhouette.

isf-gn-pixel-melt._look: Brighter pixels drip steadily downward and leave viscous vertical trails, so the picture melts into streaked curtains of its own colours.

isf-gn-pixel-repeat._look: Bright shapes repeat their outlines upward in short stepped copies, adding jagged ridged echoes, mainly in the sky. The rest of the picture is untouched. Static on a still.

isf-gn-pixel-sort-clean._look: Subtle vertical pixel sort: mid-tone areas drip short bright streaks downward that fade back into the intact picture; no motion of its own.

isf-gn-pixel-sorting._look: Persistent melt: mid-tone regions drip in feedback trails that desaturate and darken, dragging dark sheets with comb-toothed edges across the picture.

isf-gn-pixort._look: Static threshold pixel sort: bright areas streak sideways into hard horizontal scan-line smears; darker parts of the picture are untouched.

isf-gn-pixort-ae._look: Temporal pixel sort with chroma split: mid-tones drift upward in feedback trails edged with rainbow fringes; edges ghost and shimmer but the picture stays readable.

isf-gn-pixort-flow-map._look: Flow-guided pixel sort: bright edges bleed short trails with iridescent rainbow fringes, giving an oil-slick sheen over an otherwise intact picture.

isf-gn-pixort-s3._look: Heavy vector pixel sort: nearly the whole frame smears into dark, grainy ghost trails with chroma split; the subject dissolves into murky streaks.

isf-gn-q-smear-noise._look: Areas below mid brightness are eaten by black feedback voids with ragged edges that churn in jittery, quantised directions; bright areas stay clean, like ink holes.

isf-gn-signal-trinity._look: Three-band video-synth mash: rainbow moire stripes flood darks and lights, RGB-split copies, and a slowly zooming, rotating feedback layer. Loud and psychedelic.

isf-gn-slit-scan._look: Slit-scan time smear: one centre column of the picture is scanned and scrolled sideways, building a horizontally streaked time-image from black over ~10 s; replaces the picture.
isf-gn-slit-scan._why: Starts black; frame fills over ~10 s, picture replaced

isf-gn-topo-scan._look: Turns the picture into white topographic contour lines on black, traced from brightness; the lines crawl steadily through the levels and all colour is discarded.

isf-gn-xormear._look: Long horizontal motion-blur smear with faint XOR bit-flip banding: the picture ghosts into soft streaks of its own colours. No motion of its own.

isf-gn-xorter._look: Hard XOR block corruption with a persistent pixel sort: the image breaks into saturated pink, yellow and orange tiles over black vertical streaks; the subject is barely readable.

isf-god-rays._look: Adds a soft radial light-shaft glow from the frame centre, lifting brightness and haloing highlights with a grey-white wash; picture stays readable; no motion of its own.

isf-hyperspace._look: Folds the picture into a mirrored curved corridor: two copies bent toward a centre seam with black wedges top and bottom; static walls (scroll is 0 by default).

isf-im-mr-blob._look: Replaces the picture with a raymarched volumetric glow: soft out-of-focus fluorescent blobs, pink-magenta with white and amber hotspots, slowly churning. Never samples the input image.

isf-interlace._look: Video-interlace combing: alternate horizontal line bands hold the previous frame, so moving parts tear into comb stripes while still areas stay clean.

isf-interlace-mirror._look: Every other scanline is flipped left-right, so the picture overlays its own mirror image as a fine-lined, ghostly symmetric double exposure; static.

isf-jpeg-block-corruption._look: Mild JPEG-style compression: 8px blocks half-flattened with chroma bleed. Default has no displaced or DC-corrupted blocks, so the picture stays nearly intact.

isf-kaleidoscope._look: Six-way kaleidoscope folded about the bottom-left corner (default centre 0,0), turning the frame into skewed diagonal shards of the picture rather than a symmetric mandala.

isf-kaleidoscope-tile._look: Tiles the picture into a repeating diagonal wallpaper of small six-fold kaleidoscope rosettes. The source becomes pattern and is unrecognisable; it shimmers as the scene moves.

isf-key-frame-artifacts._look: Rebuilds each frame as key frame plus accumulated differences. At full-precision defaults it looks intact; drift then smears and ghosts moving parts like a slow datamosh.

isf-lens-flare._look: Film lens flare built from the picture's brightest areas: rainbow chromatic ghosts mirrored through the centre, a halo ring and lens-dirt haze over the image.

isf-line-screen._look: Turns the picture into a stark black-and-white vertical line-screen halftone, like an engraving. Colour is removed and edges sharpened, but the subject stays readable.

isf-long-exposure._look: Feedback burn-in: the picture accumulates on itself, so highlights blow out to a hazy overexposed pastel glow and moving bright parts leave fading trails.

isf-luminance-posterize._look: Bands the picture's brightness into steps. At the default 30 levels it is almost a pass-through: faint banding in skies and gradients, colours kept.

isf-mattias-crt._look: Old CRT TV: curved screen with a black bezel, fine scanlines, slow rolling scan bands, slight RGB offset, green tint and dark vignette.

isf-median._look: Median filter smooths away fine detail, giving a soft, slightly painterly picture with faint blocky smearing on edges. Colours and composition stay intact.

isf-meta-image._look: Photomosaic: an 8x8 grid of tiny copies of the whole picture, each tinted by its cell's average colour. The result is dim and darkened, and the original image is barely legible.

isf-mirror._look: Left half reflected onto the right, making the picture perfectly symmetric (a Rorschach-like, slightly surreal composition). Colours and detail are untouched.

isf-mirror-edge._look: Four-way mirror tiling: the picture repeats as a 2x2 kaleidoscope with upside-down reflections meeting in the middle. The composition is broken into mirrored quadrants.

isf-monochrome-channelmix._look: Converts the picture to black and white at boosted gain: bright, high-contrast greyscale whose highlights clip to white. Composition kept.

isf-motion-data-mosh._look: Optical-flow datamosh: the picture breaks into saturated green, pink and blue macro-blocks that smear and stick along motion, with only fragments of the image showing.

isf-multi-frame-2x2._look: 2x2 video wall: the picture shown four times, each cell a few frames later than the last, giving a stuttering echo. In the smoke test one cell was still black, probably because its buffer had not filled yet.

isf-multi-frame-3x3._look: 3x3 video wall: nine small copies of the picture, each a few frames later than the last, giving a busy stutter grid. In the smoke test the bottom row was still black, probably because those buffers had not filled yet.

isf-multi-pass-gaussian-blur._look: Very deep blur that turns the picture into a soft, featureless colour wash taking its hues from the source. Shapes vanish into smooth gradients.

isf-multi-pixellate._look: Chunky pixellation with mixed block sizes: large and small square cells of flat averaged colour. The image is reduced to a soft 8-bit-style mosaic.

isf-neon._look: Edge detection turns the picture into glowing pink neon outlines over a dark magenta-tinted frame; contours shimmer as the scene moves.

isf-noise-adapt._look: Pixels that change turn into RGB static until they settle; still areas stay clean with light grain, moving areas fizz with colour noise.

isf-noise-pixellate._look: Picture broken into small square cells filled with thresholded speckle noise; dark, gritty, subject only a blocky silhouette.

isf-old-film._look: Sepia false-colour with soft vignette, fine grain and a gentle projector flicker; the picture stays intact like an old print.

isf-optical-flow-distort._look: Moving parts smear and ripple along their motion, leaving persistent wavy streaks; static areas stay mostly intact.

isf-oscilloscope-analysis-luminance._look: Replaces the picture with a white wire grid on black whose lines bend with brightness, like an oscilloscope mesh of the scene.

isf-palettes._look: Maps brightness to a saturated cosine rainbow palette: thermal-camera false colour in magenta, yellow, green and cyan bands.

isf-pattern-glitch._look: Small random rectangles flicker into test patterns (stripes, static, bars) many times a second; the rest of the picture stays clean.

isf-physarum-polycephalum-simulation._look: Replaces the picture with a slime-mould trail simulation; by default the input is ignored and the frame reads as flat grey-blue grain.
isf-physarum-polycephalum-simulation._why: Hides picture; renders near-flat blue grain field

isf-pixel-shifter._look: Sinusoidal mirrored pixel shift sweeps the picture into long curved ribbons; the subject is stretched into smooth swooping arcs.

isf-pixellate._look: Very coarse mosaic: about eight columns of large flat colour tiles averaged from the picture; the subject is unrecognisable.

isf-poly-glitch._look: Shatters the picture into small jagged triangular shards with smeared colour fragments; dark, splintered, subject only a broken silhouette.

isf-posterize._look: Cuts the picture to about six tone bands per channel: flat contour bands with hard edges and shifted pink/teal colours. The picture stays readable, like a cheap screen print.

isf-quad-tile._look: Mirrors and tiles the picture into a 4x4 grid of reflected copies, making a symmetric wallpaper. Each copy is still recognisable. Static unless its slide and rotation knobs move.

isf-radial-replicate._look: Repeats one wedge of the picture into a 12-spoke radial starburst kaleidoscope. The subject is crushed into a spiky hub at the centre, with black corners.

isf-random-freeze._look: Only a random rectangle of the frame updates each frame and the rest holds stale pixels. Moving video turns into stuttering, lagging block patches; a still barely changes.

isf-replicate._look: Overlays offset, padded, zoomed copies of the picture into a collage: four large copies with misaligned seam strips between them. Static.

isf-replicate-random._look: Turns the picture into a dense wallpaper of tiny thumbnail copies with faint larger copies layered over them, like a video wall. The original is lost.

isf-rgb-halftone._look: Breaks the picture into separate red, green and blue halftone dot grids on black. Large solid red blocks appear along the bottom edge, which looks like an edge-sampling bug.
isf-rgb-halftone._why: Garbage red blocks along bottom edge (edge-sampling bug)

isf-rgb-halftone-lookaround._look: An RGB halftone with bigger, overlapping dots: saturated red, green and blue circles on black that blend to white in the highlights. The picture shows only as dot-size shapes. Clean edges.

isf-rgb-trails-3-0._look: A persistent blend buffer with equal 0.5 weights on every channel. Moving video leaves soft ghost trails, like motion blur; a still is unchanged.

isf-ripples._look: A radial sine warp around the centre that gently pinches and bends the picture in concentric rings. The picture stays mostly intact. Static unless its offset knob moves.

isf-saturation-bleed._look: Blurs saturation into neighbouring pixels, so colour spreads slightly past its edges. Almost invisible: the picture is essentially unchanged.

isf-sepia-tone._look: Turns the picture into a flat, slightly low-contrast amber-brown sepia, like an old photograph. Detail stays intact; all colour is replaced by warm monochrome.

isf-sharpen-luminance._look: Subtle luminance sharpen: edges and fine texture get crisper and slightly more contrasty, colours unchanged; no motion of its own beyond the beat-pulsed mix.

isf-sharpen-rgb._look: Per-channel RGB sharpen: crisper edges and texture with a little extra contrast and faint colour fringing at edges; static apart from the beat-pulsed mix.

isf-shockwave-pulse._look: On each beat a refractive ring ripples outward from the centre, bending a narrow band of the picture like a shockwave through water, then resets.

isf-sine-warp-tile._look: Sine mirror warp: the picture is folded symmetrically about the centre and bulged outward like a fisheye reflection, sky stretched into curved bands; static at defaults.

isf-sketch._look: Comic-ink outline: edges traced in dark lines over a slightly softened picture, like a cel-shaded or inked drawing; colours kept; no motion.

isf-slit-scan._look: At default (static) settings only one soft diagonal band of the picture updates; the rest stays a black stale buffer, so the art shows through a slanted slot.
isf-slit-scan._why: static params: no slit-scan, two thirds stays black

isf-smoke-screen._look: Grey fractal smoke drifts slowly along the bottom of the picture, thinning upward like low stage fog; the upper image stays untouched.

isf-smudged-lens._look: Blotchy noise-shaped patches of the picture softly blurred, as if fingerprints smear the lens; subtle and static.

isf-soft-blur._look: Strong overall soft-focus blur: the whole picture goes hazy and glowing, fine detail melting into soft colour; no motion.

isf-soft-flip._look: Diagonal split: one half of the picture shown rotated 180 degrees, blended into the upright half along a soft diagonal seam; surreal, static.

isf-solarize._look: Monochrome solarisation: colour drained to silver-grey, midtones flare white and highlights darken, giving glowing white contour lines like a darkroom print; static.

isf-sorting-smear._look: Feedback pixel-sort smear: bright areas creep and bleed into neighbours so the picture melts and drifts, then snaps back clean on every beat.

isf-sphere-map._look: Wraps the picture onto a fisheye ball centred on black, with a visible tiling seam across the middle. Static unless the rotate knobs move.

isf-stylize-glitch._look: Random rectangles of the picture flicker about 30 times a second, each inverted, dithered or hue-shifted (magenta blocks). The rest of the image stays intact.

isf-suture-fluid._look: Replaces the picture with its own evolving viscous-fingering fluid field: dense mottled blobs of blue, cyan, orange and cream that slowly swirl into worm-like channels.

isf-texture-displace._look: A gentle sine-wave wobble ripples the picture, bending its edges and horizon in slow drifting waves. The image stays fully readable.

isf-texture-displace-02._look: Slices the picture into offset horizontal bands, like a VHS tracking tear, with a star-shaped warp. The bands drift slowly and the subject breaks apart.

isf-thermal-camera._look: False-colour heat map: brightness is remapped to black, purple, blue, cyan, green, yellow, orange and red, like an infrared camera. Shapes stay intact and it adds no motion of its own.

isf-toon._look: Comic-book treatment: black ink outlines traced on edges, with lightly posterised colours. The picture stays fully readable and it adds no motion.

isf-trail-mask._look: Some pixels hold stale frames, so moving parts leave soft ghost copies and smeared trails, seen as doubled masts and streaked aurora. The image is otherwise intact.

isf-triangle-mosaic._look: Rebuilds the picture as a dense mesh of small jittered flat-colour triangles with dark outlines. The subject becomes a chunky blocky silhouette, and the mesh does not move.

isf-triangle-warp._look: Squeezes the whole picture into a pyramid-shaped triangle on black, pinched to a point at the top. Static.

isf-triangles._look: Reduces the picture to a coarse grid of big squares, each split into two averaged flat triangles. The result is a soft pastel low-poly mosaic and the subject cannot be read.

isf-trio-tone._look: Maps brightness onto a black-blue-green-red ramp in pure primaries, so the picture turns mostly saturated blue with green and red highlights. Shapes stay intact.

isf-unsharp-mask._look: Sharpening filter: edges and fine detail get crisper, colours and composition unchanged; at default strength almost invisible, no motion of its own.

isf-v002-crosshatch._look: Turns the picture into a flat two-colour crosshatch print: mint-green ground with plum/magenta hatched shadows; original colours gone, shapes read as silhouettes. Static.

isf-v002-crt-displacement._look: Barrel-bulges the picture like a curved old CRT tube, with rounded black corners and edges; colours and detail intact, static.

isf-v002-dilate._look: Max-filter dilate: highlights spread and brighten into a soft glow, fine lines vanish, with small blocky ghost copies and stair-step edges. Static.

isf-v002-erode._look: Min-filter erode: darks thicken and spread, highlights shrink, picture darkens with doubled blocky outlines and stair-stepped pixel edges. Static.

isf-v002-glitch-analog._look: At defaults just fine horizontal CRT scanlines and faint bar shading over an intact picture; distortion and sync roll are off. Static.

isf-v002-technicolor._look: Two-strip Technicolor film grade: colours pulled toward red-pink and cyan-green, a warmer old-film cast; picture fully intact, no motion.

isf-v002-vignette._look: Soft film vignette: darkens the edges and corners, drawing the eye to the centre; picture otherwise untouched, static.

isf-vertical-tearing._look: Fixed mid-screen tear line where the top half lags one frame behind the bottom; invisible on stills, a faint split only during fast motion.

isf-vhs-chaos-master-github._look: Worn VHS tape: heavy dark scanlines, RGB fringe split, smeared horizontal distortion, grain and noise; picture dimmed and blurred, noise crawling constantly.

isf-vhs-glitch._look: VHS playback fault: pink-and-blue colour bleed, grain, vertical smears, and a drifting band where the picture tears into stretched grey streaks; bands scan continuously.

isf-video-snake._look: Shrinks the picture into a 4x4 video-wall grid, each tile one frame older, so motion ripples snake-wise across tiles; starts black and fills tile by tile.

isf-waveform-displace._look: Ripples the picture in wavy horizontal bands driven by the audio waveform; edges and outlines squiggle like a reflection in choppy water, jittering frame to frame with the sound.

isf-waveform-displace-audio-as-image._look: Nudges the picture by its own edge-row brightness rather than the sound: a faint static offset with a smeared seam strip at one edge; barely changes the image.
isf-waveform-displace-audio-as-image._why: Near no-op: static shift plus edge seam, not audio-driven

isf-zooming-feedback._look: Classic video feedback: bright parts of the picture leave stepped echo copies that zoom outward from the centre, lightening the frame with ghost trails of masts and highlights.

afterimage-ghost-comets._look: Bright moving parts leave fading comet tails that hue-rotate into faint rainbow fringes; stills pass through untouched, motion and cuts smear into light-painted streaks.

afterimage-ghost-dream._look: Soft long-exposure ghosting: moving shapes and cuts linger as blurred, dusk-violet tinted afterimages that slowly dissolve; still images stay intact.

ascii_mode-colour-terminal._look: Picture rebuilt from small source-coloured monospaced glyphs with directional edge strokes; darker, fine text texture, highlights become pale glyph blocks; glyphs step up on beats.

ascii_mode-neon-code._look: Picture turned into larger glyph cells in acid magenta, green and teal drifting palette false colour; heavy glyph scramble and exposure jumps on every beat.

bass-vibrate-cone-hum._look: On each kick the picture buzzes sideways at 42 Hz into a brief motion-blurred double image with faint tinted RGB fringes, settling fast; faint idle hum between.

bass-vibrate-subwoofer._look: Kicks make the picture throb outward like a speaker cone in a slow, wide 24 Hz wobble with rainbow prism fringes, lingering about a third of a second.

beat-stutter-chop._look: On beats the whole frame freezes and repeats in short beat-locked steps with a light palette tint and flash, then fades back to live: a DJ video stutter.

beat-stutter-collage._look: Random rectangles freeze, repeat and rewind past beats as acid-tinted patches over the live picture, flashing on repeats: a shifting freeze-frame collage.

block-glitch-macroblock._look: Scattered codec macroblocks displace, freeze, smear and flip to false colour with sparkle and torn bands, reseeding about four times a second and bursting on beats.

block-glitch-shatter._look: Dense small-block digital damage shreds the whole picture into jittering acid false-colour fragments and RGB-split streaks, reseeding rapidly about eight times a second.

bloom-concert-haze._look: Highlights bleed into wide, warm palette-tinted halos, giving a milky concert-haze glow over the picture that swells on each beat.

bloom-soft-glow._look: A tight, subtle glow on the brightest highlights in near-source colours with a faint cool tint; the picture stays crisp, breathing only slightly on beats.

bulge-pinch-bubble-wrap._look: A drifting lattice of twelve glossy glass domes magnifies round patches of the picture, with candy-tinted sheen and rims, thumping outward on the beat.

bulge-pinch-speaker-cone._look: One big soft glass lens swells the centre of the picture and kicks outward on each beat like a speaker cone, with a slight prism fringe at its rim.

chroma-punch._look: Radial red/blue colour fringing outward from the centre: faint at rest, flaring into wide RGB ghosting at the edges on each beat.

chroma-soft._look: Faint radial RGB fringing toward the frame edges, barely visible, widening slightly on the beat; the picture stays intact.

crt-monitor-arcade._look: The picture on a strongly curved arcade tube inside a rounded dark bezel: chunky 240-line scanlines, shadow mask, warm bloom and corner vignette; the raster breathes on the beat.

crt-monitor-broadcast._look: A flatter broadcast monitor: fine 540-line aperture-grille scanlines, light curvature, thin bezel, soft vignette and a faint dusk tint; the picture stays crisp.

cube-grid-diagonal-wall._look: The picture split into a 10-column wall of cubes. Diagonal waves flip them a quarter turn to slide neighbouring tiles in, with neon-tinted sides and edge glints.

cube-grid-radial-flip._look: The picture shattered into a 16-column wall of tilted cubes flipping half turns in radial waves. Pink candy-tinted backs and glowing gaps replace much of the image.

dither-demo-cycle._look: The picture banded into a few neon palette colours (magenta, mint, teal, olive) with chunky Bayer dither; the colours cycle and kick on the beat.

dither-mac-1bit._look: Black-and-white blue-noise stipple at a fine pixel scale. The colour is gone and the picture becomes a greyish dot texture, with a brief crunch on the beat.

dolly-zoom-drop-lurch._look: The background looms in and smears with zoom blur and a twist around a held centre, then snaps back on each beat; ember-tinted fog fills the stretched depths.

dolly-zoom-vertigo._look: A slow push-pull perspective warp: the centre holds its size while the surroundings stretch away and loom back with a slight twist and light fog.

droste-picture-tunnel._look: Picture holds a few large nested, slightly turned copies of itself, off-centre, with glowing pink bezels, falling steadily inwards; beats speed the fall.

droste-print-gallery._look: Escher print-gallery spiral: the whole picture bends round a small nested copy of itself, cyan-edged, slowly winding and falling inwards.

edge_glow-led-trace._look: Picture turns into soft, wide pink-white glowing contours over a lightly dimmed, washed source; hazy candy plasma with slow colour drift.

edge_glow-tron-grid._look: Scene goes near-black and its edges light up as thin rainbow neon lines with glow; beats swell the glow and lurch the colours.

feedback-echo-liquid._look: Picture dissolves into slowly swirling, smeared ghost folds like rippling silk in dusky mauve and amber; detail is largely lost at full amount.

feedback-echo-tunnel._look: Radial zoom-burst trails: highlights stream outward from the centre with RGB-fringed neon echoes and a slow spin; the picture stays readable.

film_stock-bleach-bypass._look: Bleach-bypass print: colour drained to cool silver, crushed blacks, hard contrast and heavy drifting film grain.

film_stock-dye-transfer._look: Three-strip Technicolor print: colours pushed to saturated candy reds, pinks, greens and golds, red halation round highlights, light grain.

flag-wave-banner._look: Picture becomes a silk banner hung from a rod, rippling in horizontal folds with warm ember sheen; the lower edge crumples into smeared streaks.

flag-wave-pole._look: Picture as a flag on a left-hand pole, its free edge flapping in deep dark folds with silk sheen; beats send waves along it.

flash-glow-warm._look: Soft amber screen-blended brightening on each beat over a faint constant warm glow; the picture stays intact.

flash-kick._look: White flash on every kick, screen-blended with a fast decay, dark between beats; brightens rather than blanks the picture.

frame-cube-gallery._look: The picture sits on the front of a large glossy box that turns slowly on a dark reflective stage, with only a slight lurch on the beat and little tumble.

frame-cube-prism._look: A smaller box with hue-shifted lime, green and purple side faces tumbles and lurches round on every beat over a dark glossy floor. The picture is small and recoloured.

frame-cube-showcase._look: The picture becomes a mirrored glossy box on a dark reflective stage. It spins steadily and kicks round on each beat with a mild wobble.

globe-wrap-neon-planet._look: The picture is wrapped onto a small, tilted, fast-spinning planet with a hot pink, cyan and green neon rim, set in black space with dense stars.

globe-wrap-world._look: The picture curls into a large softly lit globe with a faint icy-blue atmosphere. It spins slowly over a dimmed, blurred copy of itself with sparse stars.

god-rays-cathedral._look: Bright parts of the picture throw warm white-amber light shafts from a light point near the top that orbits slowly. The beat pushes the shafts further, and the picture stays readable.

god-rays-cosmic-burst._look: A central white-hot starburst throws long pink, cyan and white prismatic shafts. At full amount it largely washes the picture out to white, and the beat pumps it hard.

grade-cool._look: A cool colour grade: reds pulled down and blues lifted, with slightly more saturation and contrast. The picture stays intact, only bluer and colder.

grade-mono._look: A black-and-white grade with strong contrast and slightly lifted blacks, like a film photograph. All colour is removed but the composition stays intact.

grade-punch._look: A vivid grade with saturation pushed hard, extra contrast, and a brightness pump of about +28% on every beat.

grade-warm._look: A warm amber grade: reds lifted and blues pulled down, with slightly richer saturation. The picture stays intact, only golden and cosier.

halftone-cmyk-print._look: Fine CMYK dot screen laid over the picture, slowly turning rosette; image stays recognisable, slightly darkened and printed-looking; dots swell gently on the beat.

halftone-pop-art._look: Flattens the picture into a hot-pink candy duotone with a large white dot screen; subjects become soft blobs; dots swell and the screen turns on the beat.

handheld-drift-documentary._look: Loose handheld camera: noticeable pan/tilt drift, visible roll and frequent eased reframes with a footstep bob; the picture itself is untouched, just restlessly filmed.

handheld-drift-steadicam._look: Slow steadicam float: soft pan, tilt and zoom breathing with rare smooth reframes and a small beat bob; the still feels filmed, picture fully intact.

hue-drift-channel-rave._look: Lurid channel-swap recolour: fire turns acid green, skies magenta, pinks go lime; colours slide R to G to B and whoosh through the spectrum on every beat.

hue-drift-rainbow-tones._look: Psychedelic recolour fanning shadows to highlights across a rainbow: fire goes green-violet, skies pink; the hue drifts slowly with a soft beat nudge.

hue-drift-rave._look: Fast saturated hue rotation: neon green fire, violet and hot-pink skies cycling through the spectrum every few seconds, kicked into a whoosh on each beat.

hue-drift-slow._look: Slow colour cast drift: pinks ease to teal, fire to violet, the scene keeps its shape; hue wanders unhurriedly with barely any beat response.

jpeg-crush-codec._look: Over-compressed codec: 8x8 blocking and mosquito noise with scattered pink, green and cyan corrupted block runs; picture readable; quality collapses into bursts on the beat.

jpeg-crush-datamosh._look: Heavy datamosh: big 16x16 macroblocks, bit-crushed acid blue, violet and green block runs and smeared P-frames; the picture is mostly shattered into blocks.

kaleido-mirror-mandala._look: Folds the picture into an 8-wedge mirrored mandala disc that grows from the centre, turns slowly and breathes, with faint coloured seam glints.

kaleido-mirror-rose-window._look: 12-fold zoomed kaleidoscope with bright rainbow spokes radiating from the centre like a rose window; spins fast and lurches hard on each beat; picture lost to pattern.

kuwahara-oil-canvas._look: Turns the picture into a smooth oil painting: flat edge-preserving brush strokes along the image's contours, boosted colour, faint drifting glaze and impasto relief; subject stays readable.

kuwahara-watercolour-wash._look: Soft round smudged strokes that melt fine detail into blurry colour pools, cool icy glaze; strokes soften and bloom on the beat.

led_wall-dip-triads._look: Picture shown on a coarse old LED panel: chunky R/G/B sub-pixel triads with dark gaps, visible module seams, banded 4-bit colour, patchy brightness; overdrives on the beat.

led_wall-stadium._look: Picture on a fine stadium LED screen: round glowing dots with dark gaps, faint pink palette tint, subtle module seams; a refresh band rolls down and LEDs overdrive on the beat.

lens-fisheye-gopro._look: Full-frame barrel bulge like an action-cam lens, darkened rim, slowly wandering centre; punches into the bulge on each beat. Picture stays whole.

lens-fisheye-peephole._look: Strong circular fisheye: the picture rounds into a bulging lens with black corners and a faint neon rim glow; the lens wanders and punches on the beat.

lens-flare-cosmic-halo._look: Heavy flare: bright areas blow out into white starbursts with a wide halo, neon ghosts and a field of bokeh dirt specks; the beat kicks it brighter.

lens-flare-prism._look: Subtle cinematic flare: lamps and bright spots throw small rainbow ghosts across the centre and a faint starburst; the picture stays intact.

light-leaks-end-of-roll._look: Big hot film leaks fog in from the edges, bleaching a third of the frame to cream with peach and magenta tints; occasional edge flashes like a roll's end.

light-leaks-golden-hour._look: Soft amber, coral and magenta film blooms drift slowly in from the frame edges, screened over the picture; centre stays clear.

liquid-warp-heat-haze._look: Faint rising heat shimmer: horizontal bands of the picture wobble gently with slight prism fringes; barely changes the image.

liquid-warp-underwater._look: The picture swirls as if seen through moving water, with pale caustic light ribbons rippling across it; slow flow.

luma-terrain-flyover._look: The picture's brightness rises into a hazy 3D mountain landscape textured by it, under a salmon-amber dusk sky, flown over slowly at low altitude; beats lift the peaks.

luma-terrain-misty-peaks._look: The picture lifts into tall fog-shrouded peaks under a grey-teal sky, drifting very slowly; muted, misty, with pale glowing summits.

mesh-wobble-faceted-spin._look: The picture is bent by a coarse lattice that twists and zooms inward, with neon cyan-magenta sheen rings; hard beat kicks lurch the whole frame.

mesh-wobble-jelly._look: The picture wobbles like jelly: large smooth rubbery bends, squash and stretch, bouncing on the beat; colours stay intact with a faint sheen.

mirror-ball-glitter._look: A large fine-faceted silver disco ball hangs mid-frame reflecting the dimmed picture, throwing dense white light specks that sweep slowly round.

mirror-ball-party._look: A mid-size disco ball lowers into the top of the frame, throwing pastel rainbow-gelled light specks that sweep across the lightly dimmed picture.

neon_contours-rainbow-isobars._look: Dense thin contour lines, each its own rainbow colour, trace the picture's brightness over a half-dimmed source and march steadily downhill.

neon_contours-topo-neon._look: Thick glowing neon tubes in magenta, teal and pale yellow trace the picture's brightness contours over a near-black source, marching uphill and swelling on beats.

ocean-mirror-billboard._look: The picture shrinks to a small billboard on a dark horizon above a black, choppy night sea that reflects it, with a bright white glitter streak.

ocean-mirror-sunset._look: The picture becomes a wide mirrored sky on the horizon above a calm sea that reflects it, with a gentle swell and a bright sun glitter.

palette-map-duotone-glow._look: Recolours the picture into an ember duotone, with brown-black shadows and burnt-orange highlights, plus a slow colour drift and a saturation punch on beats.

palette-map-hue-drift._look: Gently rotates the picture's hues (reds drift to magenta, blues toward green) while keeping its structure and most of its colours; slow drift.

pixel-sort-hue-shear._look: Whole frame hue-sorted sideways into long jagged horizontal streaks; the picture smears into scanline-like colour bands with a faint neon tint, surging on beats.

pixel-sort-pour._look: Mid and bright tones melt downward into pale acid-tinted vertical drip streaks over the picture, growing over frames and surging on the beat; image mostly readable.

polar-wrap-tiny-planet._look: Picture rolled into a slowly turning little planet: landscape curls into a ring around a pinched core, dusk-tinted crease glow, gentle spin and scroll.

polar-wrap-tunnel._look: Picture becomes a mirrored tight spiral vortex of its own colours with a glowing core, rings streaming outward endlessly; the original image is unrecognisable.

pool-view-deep-end._look: Picture becomes a deep pool floor under choppy blue-tinted water: dense white caustic web, tilted camera, cream tiled rim around a shrunken frame.

pool-view-lido._look: Picture seen through clear sunny pool water: gentle waves wobble it, white caustic lines and glints dance, a thin tiled rim frames it; light aqua tint.

rain-on-glass-storm._look: Heavily fogged window over the picture: dense big beads and fast runners streak down, image blurred to muted blue-grey haze, lightning flashes on beats.

rain-on-glass-window._look: Rainy window pane in front of the picture: beads and slow runners trickle down, each a tiny lens; lightly fogged glass softens the still-visible image.

rain-ripples-downpour._look: Picture as a puddle in heavy rain: many interfering ripple rings refract it, bright glints catch the crests, a big splash ring on each beat.

rain-ripples-drizzle._look: A few faint soft rings spread across the still picture like drizzle on a puddle, one larger ring on each beat; image almost untouched.

rotate-wobble-dutch-sway._look: Picture overscanned and rocking like a pendulum: a gentle Dutch-tilt roll with slight 3D lean, beats push each swing side to side; no edges show.

rotate-wobble-hanging-card._look: Picture shrunk to a glossy shadowed card swinging in 3D from its top edge over a dark magenta-tinted backdrop, pushed by the beats.

rutt-etra-classic._look: The picture redrawn as fine glowing horizontal scanlines in its own colours, lifted by brightness into a relief on a slowly swaying tilted plane over black; ridges rise on the kick.

rutt-etra-mono-grid._look: The picture becomes a neon yellow, magenta and cyan wireframe terrain on a steeply tilted plane over black; the ridges heave on each kick and the source colours are gone.

shake-beat._look: The whole picture jolts and rolls slightly on each kick, over a faint idle sway; it is zoomed in just enough to keep the edges covered.

shake-sway._look: A slow, smooth, handheld-like drift and slight roll of the whole picture that the beat barely touches.

shockwave-kick-ring._look: On each kick a faint refracting ring ripples out from the centre with a thin chromatic fringe and soft glow; otherwise the picture is untouched.

shockwave-prism-blast._look: On each kick a big rainbow-glowing ring bursts from the centre and sweeps fast across the screen, refracting the picture under its wide chromatic front.

sketch_hatch-coloured-pencil._look: The picture redrawn as coloured-pencil hatching and dark ink lines on pinkish toned paper, with muted candy tints; the strokes boil and redraw about ten times a second.

sketch_hatch-ink-sketchbook._look: The picture redrawn in near-monochrome ink lines and dense cross-hatching on cream-grey paper; the colour is mostly gone and the strokes boil gently.

smear-drag-melt._look: Bright parts of the picture drip and melt downward in soft meandering streaks with a faint iridescent tint, bursting on the beat and then recovering toward the live image.

smear-drag-wind._look: Dark tones streak sideways in soft, meandering, wind-blown smears across the picture, with a faint icy tint on the trails.

snowfall-flurry._look: Dense windswept snow in parallax layers, with big soft bokeh flakes near the camera and a dusk tint; it gusts and sparkles on the beat, with light frost at the edges.

snowfall-hush._look: Sparse, soft bokeh snowflakes drift gently down while frost creeps in at the frame edges, under a cool blue grade.

spark-overlay-forge._look: White-hot streaked sparks burst from the picture's highlights (lamps, moon) on each kick, fall under gravity and cool to ember orange; dense glitter on bright images.

spark-overlay-rising-embers._look: Pale glowing motes rise from a bright band along the bottom edge and drift upward on turbulent air, larger and slower than sparks; bursts on the kick.

split-tone-grade-dusk-tritone._look: Strong tritone gradient map: the whole picture recoloured into indigo, violet and pink-magenta, keeping its light and structure; hue drifts very slowly.

split-tone-grade-teal-orange._look: Subtle cinematic grade: teal-tinted shadows and warm peach-orange highlights over the intact picture, slight contrast punch on the beat.

spring-punch-rubber-jolt._look: Each kick jolts the frame sideways, alternating left and right, squashing and wobbling back like rubber, with motion blur and candy-coloured ghost trails.

spring-punch-zoom-bounce._look: The frame punches in on each kick and rebounds with a springy overshoot, slight squash and radial motion blur; the picture stays whole.

strobe_flash-drop-white._look: Punchy near-full-frame white flash on the beat (capped brightness, max 3/s) with a slight RGB tear; picture almost untouched between hits.

strobe_flash-solar-glitch._look: Beat-driven solarise/invert flashes on edges and highlights with a strongly staggered RGB strobe in acid colours, and a faint solarised wash between beats.

sync-fault-lost-signal._look: Lost analogue signal: the picture rolls, smears into horizontal streaks with heavy tearing, interlace combing, black blanking bars and acid colour drift; barely recognisable.

sync-fault-v-hold._look: Old-TV vertical hold slip: the picture rolls with a black blanking bar and teletext dashes, light tear bands and RGB fringing, then catches on the downbeat.

tile-split-hex-mirror._look: Picture tiled into a dense five-across hex hive of mirrored, swinging cells with rainbow-glowing bezels, forming kaleidoscopic patterns; rows slide on the beat.

tile-split-video-wall._look: Picture repeated on a 3x3 wall of screens with dark bezels that flash colour; rows slide sideways on the beat and spring back, with a gentle sway.

time-slice-rgb-glitch._look: Noise-map slit-scan: moving areas smear into blotchy patches from different moments, with wide red/green/blue time lag and faint neon tint; beats lurch it back in time.

time-slice-rubber-rings._look: Radial slit-scan: the centre shows now, outer rings show the recent past, so moving content stretches like rubber in soft rings with slight colour lag; stills unchanged.

trauma-shake-camera._look: Handheld camera jolt: each beat kicks a quick x/y/roll shake of the whole picture that decays fast, with slight overscan and motion blur; picture stays intact.

trauma-shake-earthquake._look: Slow heavy rumble: the picture lurches mostly vertically and rolls up to a few degrees, motion-blurred, with a constant base tremor and long decay after beats.

tunnel-wall-hyperspace._look: The picture tiles a square corridor of concentric rectangles racing past with a spiral twist, bright neon ring outlines and a white-hot exit glowing at the centre.

tunnel-wall-journey._look: The picture lines a rounded, banking tube flown through at steady pace; mirrored walls stream past with faint ring lights into a soft glowing exit.

twirl-paint-stir._look: Two counter-rotating whirlpools stir the picture into marbled double curls like wet paint, with faint candy-tinted spiral arms; twists harder on beats, then unwinds.

twirl-whirlpool._look: One big centred vortex winds the whole picture into a tight spiral whirlpool; beats crank the twist hard, then it slowly unwinds.

vhs-chewed-tape._look: Badly chewed VHS on a curved tube: washed-out sepia-ember colour, dense white static streaks, big rolling tracking bands that burst on beats.

vhs-worn-tape._look: Lightly worn VHS on a curved tube: soft scanlines, slight colour bleed and dusky cast, occasional static streaks and a slow tracking band; picture mostly intact.

wave-warp-breathe._look: Long, slow sine swells roll diagonally through the picture, bending it gently like silk with a light sheen on the folds; picture stays intact.

wave-warp-tile-grid._look: Short crossed square-ish waves cut the picture into a wobbling tiled grid with visible seam lines and jagged meander edges; surges on the beat.

glt-advanced-mosaic._look: Both pictures pixelate into ever larger flat colour blocks (about 5x4 at the midpoint, picture gone) while cross-fading, then the blocks shrink back into B.

glt-angular._look: A hard-edged clock wipe: a line pivots around the centre like a clock hand, sweeping B in over A as a growing pie slice.

glt-block-dissolve._look: B appears in tiny random square blocks scattered across A, a busy pixel-confetti mix of both pictures until B fills the frame.

glt-book-flip._look: A turns like a book page from right to left, skewed in faux 3D and shaded as it folds edge-on, uncovering B beneath.

glt-bounce._look: A drops out of the frame like a ball, bouncing three times with a soft dark shadow on its edge, leaving B behind.

glt-bow-tie-horizontal._look: Two hard-edged triangles of B push in from the left and right edges, tips meeting at the centre, then widen into a bow tie that fills the frame.

glt-bow-tie-vertical._look: Two hard-edged triangles of B grow down from the top and up from the bottom, meeting at the centre as a bow tie that widens to fill the frame.

glt-bow-tie-with-parameter._look: Two stages: wedges of B close in from top and bottom into a bow tie, then A's remaining side wedges retreat to the left and right edges.

glt-box._look: A shrinks into a hard-edged centred box (cropped, not scaled) that closes to a point, with B showing all around it.

glt-burn0._look: A burns away in irregular noise-shaped patches whose edges glow orange-yellow like film or paper catching fire, revealing B beneath.

glt-cannabisleaf._look: A jagged cannabis-leaf silhouette of B grows from the centre, tiny at first then ballooning fast to fill the frame.
glt-cannabisleaf._why: cannabis-leaf emblem reads as a drug symbol, not art

glt-chessboard._look: A 10-wide checkerboard: every other square wipes left-to-right to B, then the remaining squares follow, breaking both pictures into a grid midway.

glt-circleopen._look: A soft-edged circular iris opens from the centre, revealing the incoming image inside a growing round window over the outgoing one.

glt-colorphase._look: Crossfade where red, then green, then blue channels switch at different times, so the midpoint passes through a strong colour-cast double exposure.

glt-coord-from-in._look: Each image's colours become sampling coordinates for the other, smearing both into a fragmented, solarised collage of torn shapes before settling on the new image.

glt-crazy-parametric-fun._look: The outgoing image is torn into pulsing concentric ripple rings and moire bands spreading from the centre, a psychedelic swirl that fades into the new image.

glt-cross-zoom._look: Both images streak into a strong radial zoom blur whose centre slides across the frame, crossfading at the peak of the blur and resolving sharp.

glt-crosshatch._look: The incoming image appears through thin random horizontal and vertical lines that thicken into a plaid grid until it fills the frame.

glt-directional._look: A hard-edged vertical push: the incoming image slides in at constant speed and shoves the outgoing one off the screen.

glt-directional-easing._look: Vertical push with easing: the incoming image shoots in fast and decelerates smoothly, pushing the outgoing one off the frame.

glt-directional-scaled._look: Both images shrink into framed cards on black while sliding vertically, like a slideshow carousel swipe, then the new one grows back to full screen.

glt-directionalwipe._look: A broad, very soft diagonal wipe: the new image drifts in from one corner behind a wide gradient edge, close to a crossfade.

glt-displacement._look: A crossfade through a wobbly noise displacement map: both images ripple sideways into wavy, melted shapes, with some hard dark squiggle edges, before settling.

glt-dissolve._look: The outgoing image burns away, darkest areas first, behind a glowing red-to-amber edge, like paper catching fire, revealing the new image.

glt-dreamy._look: Soft crossfade; both images ripple gently up and down in a slow vertical wave as they blend, like a hazy double exposure.

glt-drop-zone-flicker._look: Stuttering glitch cut: blocks of the new image flicker in and out with RGB split, red/cyan colour washes and jitter, flashing back to the old image before landing.

glt-edge-transition._look: The outgoing image dims to glowing neon outlines of its edges on black, then the incoming image's outlines appear and fill back in.

glt-fadecolor._look: Classic dip to black: the outgoing image fades to black, holds briefly, and the incoming image fades up.

glt-fadegrayscale._look: Crossfade where both images drain to grey in the middle, like an old photograph, then colour returns on the incoming image.

glt-flyeye._look: Image dissolves through a fine grid of fly's-eye lenses with red/blue colour fringing, smearing into the incoming image which then sharpens.

glt-fold._look: Hard vertical seam sweeps left to right: the incoming image stretches in from the left while the outgoing one squashes into the right side.

glt-fragment._look: The outgoing image breaks into about ten large hard-edged shards that slide off-screen in one direction, revealing the incoming image beneath.

glt-glitch-displace._look: Brightness-driven displacement smears both images into a washed-out, doubled grey flash at the midpoint, then snaps into the incoming image.

glt-glitch-memories._look: Crossfade with the whole frame shaking every frame into split red, green and blue ghosts, VHS-like; the jitter dies away as the new image settles.

glt-heart._look: A hard-edged heart-shaped hole grows from the centre and reveals the incoming image until it fills the screen.

glt-hexagonalize._look: Both images break into growing hexagonal mosaic tiles, crossfade as a soft pastel honeycomb at the midpoint, then sharpen back into the incoming image.

glt-horizontal-close._look: B closes in over A as two very soft-edged gradient bands from the top and bottom edges, meeting at a horizontal centre line; like slow curtains closing.

glt-horizontal-open._look: B opens out of a soft horizontal band in the middle, spreading up and down to the edges over A; a soft-edged curtain or eyelid reveal.

glt-hsvfade._look: Crossfade done in HSV space: hues sweep through in-between colours, so mid-way the whole frame takes a garish green or magenta cast before B's colours settle.

glt-left-right._look: B slides in from the right as a hard-edged full panel while A shrinks toward the centre and dims to black inside black margins.

glt-linear-blur._look: A goes soft and hazy as it dissolves into B, which sharpens back up; at the mid-point both are a blurred wash with faint stepped ghosting.

glt-luminance-melt._look: A breaks into thin random vertical streaks that drip away from the top corner, revealing B through rain-like stripes; bright areas of A linger longest.

glt-morph._look: A dissolves into B while each picture smears and shifts by the other's colours, a soft liquid warp with ghosted doubles that settles as B arrives.

glt-mosaic-transition._look: Picture pixelates into ever-coarser flat-colour blocks, about a 10x10 grid at the mid-point, cross-blends, then the blocks shrink back to a sharp B.

glt-multiply-blend._look: Dissolve that passes through a multiplied overlay of both pictures, so the frame dips darker and richer mid-way before B lifts in.

glt-old-tv-lost-signal._look: Crossfade with a mild CRT feel: faint scanlines and a few flickering horizontal lines that tear sideways, strongest at the mid-point.

glt-overexposure._look: Dissolve that blooms into a blown-out white glare mid-way, both pictures washed pale, then B settles back to normal exposure.

glt-parametric-glitch._look: A smears into rippling, banded displacement driven by its own colours, with fragments sliding sideways and up, while B fades in underneath.

glt-perlin._look: Hard-edged noise blobs of the incoming image open up across the outgoing one and spread until they merge, like puddles growing over the picture.

glt-pinwheel._look: Eight hard-edged radial wedges of the incoming image spin out from the centre like pinwheel blades, widening until they fill the frame.

glt-polar-function._look: A five-petalled flower-shaped iris with a hard edge grows from the centre, revealing the incoming image inside it.

glt-polka-dots-curtain._look: A grid of polka dots carrying the incoming image swells from one corner across the frame, like a halftone sweep, until the dots merge.

glt-power-kaleido._look: The outgoing image folds into a rotating, many-mirrored triangular kaleidoscope, crossfades inside it, then unfolds as the incoming image.

glt-puzzle-right._look: Black dividers cut the frame into a 4x4 grid; tiles squash and flip one at a time at random, through black gaps, to the incoming image.

glt-radial._look: A soft, wide-feathered clock-hand wipe sweeps around the centre, gradually replacing the outgoing image with the incoming one.

glt-random-noisex._look: A per-pixel random dissolve: the incoming image appears as scattered speckles, like TV static, that thicken until they fill the frame.

glt-randomsquares._look: A 10x10 grid of squares, each crossfading softly at a random moment, so the incoming image builds up as a patchwork mosaic.

glt-ripple._look: A slow crossfade in which the outgoing image wobbles with faint concentric water ripples spreading from the centre as the incoming image fades up.

glt-rolls._look: The outgoing image swings away as a rigid card pivoting on a corner, its diagonal edge sweeping across to uncover the incoming image behind it.

glt-rotate-scale-fade._look: The picture spins one full turn while zooming in to a soft, blurry 8x close-up and back out, crossfading to the incoming image over grey corners.

glt-rotate-scale-vanish._look: Outgoing image spins one full turn and shrinks into the centre over a black surround while the incoming image fades up beneath it.

glt-rotate-transition._look: Whole frame spins a full turn about the centre, corners wrapping into tiled copies, while A crossfades into B; upside-down double exposure midway.

glt-scale-in._look: Incoming image starts hugely magnified at the centre and pulls back to full frame while crossfading over the still outgoing image; soft double exposure.

glt-simple-zoom._look: Smooth push-in toward the centre of the outgoing image, then the incoming image fades in over the magnified frame.

glt-simple-zoom-out._look: Incoming image bursts out of a magnified, streaky centre and eases back into place while fading in over the static outgoing image.

glt-slides._look: Outgoing image shrinks as a hard-edged inset toward the top edge, revealing the incoming image full-frame behind it.

glt-split-slide-in-horizontal._look: Incoming image slides in as top and bottom halves from opposite sides, hard edges meeting to cover the still outgoing image.

glt-split-slide-in-out-horizontal._look: Split push: top and bottom halves slide sideways in opposite directions, pushing A out and dragging B in at once along a hard seam.

glt-split-slide-in-out-vertical._look: Split push: left and right halves slide up and down in opposite directions, pushing A out and dragging B in at once along a hard centre seam.

glt-split-slide-in-vertical._look: Incoming image slides in as left and right halves from top and bottom, hard edges meeting to cover the still outgoing image.

glt-split-slide-out-horizontal._look: Outgoing image splits into top and bottom halves that slide off sideways in opposite directions, uncovering the still incoming image.

glt-split-slide-out-vertical._look: Outgoing image splits into left and right halves that slide off up and down in opposite directions, uncovering the still incoming image.

glt-squareswire._look: A grid of hard-edged squares grows across the frame along a soft diagonal sweep, the incoming image appearing inside each square until they join.

glt-squeeze._look: The outgoing image is squashed vertically into a shrinking horizontal band with red/blue fringing, like a CRT switching off, uncovering the incoming image behind.

glt-star-wipe._look: A five-pointed star with a thin white outline grows from the centre, revealing the incoming image inside it; a classic kitsch video-editor wipe.

glt-static-fade._look: Coloured TV static floods the whole screen, peaking at full cover mid-way, where it hard-cuts to the incoming image, then the noise clears.

glt-static-wipe._look: A top-to-bottom wipe whose edge is a wide, soft band of grey TV snow that swells mid-way and hides much of both images.

glt-strip-datamosh-glitch._look: Both images torn into jittering horizontal strips and slits with heavy chroma shift, scanlines, noise and white flash frames, the new image bleeding through the corruption.

glt-swap._look: Both images become floating panels on black with a mirror-floor reflection; they recede in perspective and swap places, the incoming one coming forward.

glt-swirl._look: Both images twist into a tight spiral vortex while crossfading; mid-way the picture is a whirlpool of smeared colour rings, then unwinds into the new image.

glt-tiles-wave._look: An 8x8 grid of tiles flip like cards one after another, column by column, so the incoming image sweeps in from left to right.

glt-top-bottom._look: The incoming image pushes up from the bottom while the outgoing one shrinks and darkens above it, leaving black margins around it.

glt-undulating-burn-out._look: A circle with a wobbling, wavy dark-rimmed edge grows from the centre, revealing the incoming image like a pulsing iris.

glt-vertical-close._look: The incoming image closes in from the left and right edges toward the centre with soft, feathered edges, like gently drawn curtains.

glt-vertical-open._look: B opens from a soft vertical line in the centre outward to both side edges, with wide soft gradient edges; A fades away at the sides. Smooth and symmetrical.

glt-wind._look: A ragged left-to-right wipe: each row's edge is offset at random, so B arrives as a comb of soft horizontal streaks, like the image being blown away.

glt-windowblinds._look: A crossfade through horizontal bands that multiply as it runs (up to about 100 thin stripes). Alternate bands run ahead, so the stripes shimmer like scanlines before settling into a plain fade.

glt-windowslice._look: Ten hard-edged vertical slices: in each one a bar of B widens, staggered so the reveal sweeps left to right like opening louvres.

glt-wipe-down._look: A plain hard-edged wipe: a horizontal line sweeps from top to bottom at a steady pace, with B above it replacing A. A basic broadcast-style wipe.

glt-wipe-left._look: A plain hard-edged wipe: a vertical line sweeps from right to left at a steady pace, with B behind it replacing A, like a slide change.

glt-wipe-right._look: A plain hard-edged wipe: a vertical line sweeps from left to right at a steady pace, with B behind it replacing A, like a slide change.

glt-wipe-up._look: A plain hard-edged wipe: a horizontal line rises from bottom to top at a steady pace, with B below it replacing A, like a curtain lifting.

glt-x-axis-translation._look: A slides off to the right behind a hard vertical seam. The area it uncovers shows a ghostly half-crossfade of A and B, so A appears twice until the end.

glt-zoom-in-circles._look: A splits into concentric rings, each zooming in at its own speed with lens-like seams. In the last fifth, B bursts out of the centre as a fast-growing circle.

glt-zoom-in-out._look: An accelerating dive into the centre of A until the screen is one flat blurred colour, then a matching pull-back out of B.

glt-zoom-left-wipe._look: Two stages: A pushes in to 2x and eases back out over the first half, then B wipes in with a hard edge from the right edge to the left.

glt-zoom-rigth-wipe._look: Outgoing image punches in to about 2x and eases back out over the first half, then the incoming image wipes across left to right behind a hard vertical edge.

black-hole-swallow-event-horizon._look: A black hole with an amber accretion disc and photon ring lenses and swirls the old picture into a horizon that fills the screen with black; a white-hole flash then ejects the new picture, twisting.

black-hole-swallow-quasar._look: A faster, heavier black hole: strong lensing and anticlockwise twist drag the picture past an iridescent neon disc into black, then a bright flash spirals the new picture out.

burn-2s._look: A ragged, noise-shaped flame front with a glowing orange edge and a charred rim eats through the old picture, revealing the new one behind it.

butterfly-wave-hypno-rings._look: A quick 1 s dissolve: the old picture wobbles into soft concentric ring ripples with mild RGB fringing as the new picture settles out of them.

butterfly-wave-scrawl._look: In 1 s the old picture is torn into vertical, wavy, RGB-split bands like warped TV tracking; the new picture snaps out of the same ripples.

colour-distance-hue-glow._look: Regions switch to the new picture in order of hue similarity: mottled, ragged patches give way with flecks and a faint coloured glow on the switching edges.

colour-distance-settle._look: A content-aware dissolve: bold, smoothed regions of the new picture appear where the two images already match, then the rest settles in with soft edges and no glow.

confetti_burst-gold-rain._look: A band of glinting gold and copper foil confetti rains down over 4.5 s, sparkling, then settles into place to build the new picture.

confetti_burst-party-pop._look: The old picture explodes from the centre into thousands of tumbling, multicoloured rainbow confetti chips with glints, which fall away to reveal the new picture.

crossfade-1s._look: A plain, quick 1 s opacity blend from the old picture to the new one.

crossfade-3s._look: A plain 3 s opacity blend from the old picture to the new one.

crossfade-6s._look: A slow 6 s opacity blend: the two pictures overlay as a long double exposure before the new one takes over.

crt-power-channel-change._look: Old picture tears and rolls with tracking lines and RGB ghosting, squashes to a white-hot line and a flaring dot on black, then the new picture springs open on a curved scanlined tube.

crt-power-clean-switch._look: No signal glitch: the old picture squashes quickly to a glowing line and a neon-tinted dot on black, then the new picture springs open with overshoot, curvature and scanlines.

cube-classic._look: Both scenes sit on faces of a 3D cube that turns sideways, pulling back slightly over a green-tinted glossy floor with a soft reflection, then pushing in on the new face.

cube-showroom._look: The cube pulls far back and tumbles the other way, floating small and high over a dark violet glossy floor with a strong mirror reflection, before pushing in on the new scene.

cube-inside-quarter-turn._look: Camera inside a box room yaws 90 degrees from the wall showing the old scene to the wall showing the new one; thin glowing seams, mirrored copies on side walls, floor and ceiling.

cube-inside-vertigo._look: Slower 180-degree turn through two walls of a mirrored box room with a strong dolly-zoom stretch and bank; bright acid-green seams and kaleidoscopic copies fold around the viewer.

datamosh-drag._look: Moderate datamosh: the frozen old picture is smeared block by block by the new scene's motion, with pixel-block noise, until blocks refresh into the new scene.

datamosh-meltdown._look: Heavy datamosh: fast, jittery block drag with strong DCT noise, torn horizontal rows, chroma split and scanlines shred the old picture before the new scene resolves.

defocus-dream-bokeh._look: Slow, deep defocus: the old scene melts into large soft hexagonal bokeh with colour fringing, a long crossfade happens while blurred, then focus breathes back in on the new scene.

defocus-rack-focus._look: Cinematic rack focus: the old scene softens moderately, a short swap happens at peak blur, and the new scene snaps cleanly back into focus.

doorway-grand._look: Old picture splits down the middle into two doors that swing away in perspective; warm amber light spills through the gap and the new scene rushes forward over a glossy floor.

doorway-hatch._look: A hot magenta laser line cuts the picture horizontally; top and bottom panels hinge apart in deep perspective, cold blue-white light floods out and the new scene surges forward.

edge-neon-line-art._look: Old picture's outlines light up as multicoloured neon tubes and blow out toward white, then morph into the new picture's outlines before its fill returns; mild flash.

edge-neon-overexposed._look: Hot-pink neon edges flare and the frame overexposes almost to pure white at the crossover, then the new picture resolves out of the glare.

film-burn-flare-out._look: Picture defocuses and jitters while many pink, red and white bokeh-like light leaks bloom and drift; it nearly whites out, then the new scene sharpens through scattered orbs.

film-burn-warm-leak._look: Large cream and amber film light leaks sweep across a softly defocused blend; the new picture burns in through them as they fade.

flow-morph-heat-haze._look: Soft liquid crossfade: the old picture shimmers and smears slightly like heat haze while the new one bleeds in along the same gentle currents.

flow-morph-luma-push._look: The new scene's bright shapes push up through the old picture, which smears and swirls away along luminance contours before the new image settles.

frost_spread-glacier-shards._look: White crack lines race in from the edges into a dense mosaic of small frosted ice cells, cells swap to the new picture, then the ice thaws from the centre.

frost_spread-hoarfrost._look: Old picture slowly frosts over from the edges into large cracked Voronoi ice cells under a pale veil; cells turn to the new picture and the ice thaws away.

glitch._look: Fast 0.8 s cut: torn horizontal slices jump sideways with RGB split and noise bands, flickering between old and new pictures.

hex-grid-reveal-diagonal._look: Frame tiles into hexagons sweeping diagonally; each old patch shrinks to a point as the new one blooms out, with neon-glowing pink/teal cell edges. 2 s.

hex-grid-reveal-voronoi-luma._look: Picture crazes into small drifting Voronoi cells with bright pink-white candy outlines, switching brightest areas first; dense crackle-glaze mid-way. 2.5 s.

ink-bleed-indigo-pools._look: Seven blue-grey ink pools soak outward with grainy fibrous wet edges, showing the new picture in tinted greyscale before colour floods in. 3.5 s.

ink-bleed-sepia-wash._look: A few large soft sepia-grey ink blots spread slowly across the frame; the new picture arrives as warm greyscale ink, colour seeping in late. 4.5 s.

kaleido-morph-hex-storm._look: Old picture folds fast into a dense, fast-spinning hexagonal mirror tiling of crinkled repeats, crossfades while folded, then unfolds into the new scene. 1.8 s.

kaleido-morph-mirror-prism._look: Picture folds into a spinning triangular mirror kaleidoscope with thin glowing star seams, crossfades at full fold, then unfolds into the new scene. 1.8 s.

luma-3s._look: The new picture appears through its own brightest areas first, a soft luminance-keyed dissolve spreading to the darker parts over 3 s.

melt-2s._look: Doom-style screen melt: the old picture slides down in narrow ragged columns under gravity, revealing the new one behind with a soft shadow. 2 s.

mosaic-deep-dive._look: Camera swoops far back to a wall of many small turned tiles of both scenes with neon grout and bevels, pans across, then dives into a new-scene tile. 2 s.

mosaic-tile-wall._look: Camera pulls back to a modest wall of tiles of old and new scenes, some turned, with thin dusk grout, pans and dives into a new-scene tile. 2 s.

page-curl-book-turn._look: Old picture turns away from the right edge like a book page, rolling over to show a grey paper back with faint show-through and a soft shadow. 2 s.

page-curl-corner-peel._look: Old picture peels diagonally from the bottom-right corner like a sticker, a tight glossy roll showing a pink-tinted mirrored back and casting a shadow. 2 s.

paper-burn-ember._look: A ragged hole burns open from just below centre: white-hot ember edge, black char, rising sparks and faint smoke spread over 3.5 s until the old picture is consumed, revealing the new.

paper-burn-wildfire._look: Fire climbs from the bottom edge: a rough fractal burn front with a wide char band, heavy smoke and dense sparks eats the old picture in 3 s, the new one behind.

particle-reassemble-sandstorm._look: The old picture crumbles into fine glowing dust that a sideways wind and swirling turbulence blow off over dark gaps; the new picture's grains drift in and settle over 4 s.

particle-reassemble-supernova._look: The picture bursts upward into neon-tinted glittering dust thrown towards the camera over near-black, like a starfield, then the new picture's sparks swirl in and lock into place.

pixelate-1.5s._look: The old picture steps into ever-larger square mosaic blocks, crossfades to the new at the coarsest point, then steps back down to sharp, in 1.5 s.

portal-ring-firestorm._look: A spinning ring of orange sparks opens at the centre and expands past the edges, embers flying outward; the new picture shows through it, magnified and settling into place.

portal-ring-stargate._look: A thin, fast-spinning ring of white-blue sparks with a cold glow opens at the centre and widens past the frame, revealing the new picture with deep parallax inside.

prism-columns-neon-wave._look: The picture splits into eight vertical prisms that turn in a left-to-right wave over a dark backdrop, flashing neon-outlined glass faces in pink, cyan and yellow before the new picture lands.

prism-columns-split._look: The picture parts into five tall slabs that pull apart in depth from the centre while the camera swings back; frosted-glass faces glint on a grey backdrop as the new picture turns in.

revolve-twist-through._look: The frame softly twists and zooms into a motion-blurred swirl, swaps pictures inside the spin with only a faint tinted haze, then unwinds into the new picture in 1 s.

revolve-vortex-flash._look: The frame whips into a tight, deeply zoomed spiral with heavy blur and peaks in a pastel pink-blue white-out flash at the core, then unwinds into the new picture in 1 s.

shatter-gale._look: Old picture cracks from a left-of-centre impact into a dozen large glass shards that blow sideways off frame as on a gust, faint ember edge glints, new scene beneath.

shatter-smash._look: Fast radial glass smash: bright crack web from the centre, 22 small shards spin hard, recede and burst outward with white edge glints, revealing the new scene.

sphere-grid-cascade._look: Picture breaks into a grid of glossy marble-like balls that inflate, roll over in a staggered random wave while bobbing forward, then flatten into the new picture.

sphere-grid-globe._look: Whole picture inflates into one big glossy glass globe with a pale icy seam that rolls sideways half a turn, bringing the new scene round, then flattens.

stargate-slitscan-corridor._look: Old picture squeezes into a vertical glowing slit; left and right walls of multicoloured neon slit-scan light stream toward you, then the corridor opens onto the new scene.

stargate-slitscan-floor-rush._look: Picture flattens into a wide horizontal band; floor and ceiling planes of muted pink and grey light streaks rush past fast, then open out onto the new scene.

tile_flip_3d-burst._look: Frame splits into a fine grid of small tiles with thick dark dividers; tiles snap-flip on a diagonal axis in a radial burst from the centre, revealing the new scene.

tile_flip_3d-wave._look: A wall of eight-across tiles with thin dark dividers flips over sideways in perspective as a diagonal wave, thin neon rims catching light, showing the new scene.

tri-scatter-cosmic-swarm._look: Old picture dissolves into a dense swarm of tiny rainbow-glinting triangles that spiral away like glitter over a dim backdrop, while the new scene assembles from incoming shards.

tri-scatter-shatter._look: Picture breaks into mid-sized spinning triangles that sweep away left to right with neon rim glow over a dark backdrop as the new scene assembles behind.

tv-static-band-wipe._look: Old TV losing tracking: rows tear sideways, black blanking bars roll, and a thin band of grey snow wipes the new picture down from the top.

tv-static-lost-signal._look: Picture tears and rolls, then a full screen of coarse grey colour-flecked snow swallows it for the middle beats before the new scene rolls in out of the noise.

venetian_blinds-classic._look: 14 horizontal slats flip over in a top-to-bottom wave, old picture on the fronts and new on the backs; metal edges glint and the camera tilts slightly.

venetian_blinds-shutter-burst._look: 28 thin slats at 30 degrees flip outward from the centre with jittered timing. Neon edges flash white and cyan, and a strong camera tilt opens black corner wedges.

warp-speed-hyperspace._look: The old picture stretches into radial star streaks that speed up into a full blue-white flash at the midpoint. The new picture then decelerates into place as the streaks settle.

warp-speed-neon-spin._look: A hyperspace jump: longer, denser star streaks twist with an 18-degree spin and a strong zoom punch into a cyan-white flash. The new picture then spins down into place.

warp-sweep-camera-push._look: A wide, blurry front sweeps from right to left. The whole old picture swells toward the viewer while the new one settles to full size, like a quick camera push.

warp-sweep-iris-rush._look: A circle bursts open from the centre in one second. The new picture arrives heavily magnified and snaps to size, while the old one rushes outward past a swirling edge.

warp-sweep-smear-edge._look: A crisp, gently curved edge sweeps diagonally up-left with a thin lens-like smear along it. Behind it the new picture is revealed cleanly, with no zoom.

water-drop-rain-cascade._look: Four drops splash in turn. Glossy, bubble-like rings of refraction with bright glints expand and merge, each disc carrying the new picture in.

water-drop-still-pond._look: A single drop lands mid-frame. One soft refracting ring with a faint glint spreads slowly outward, revealing the new picture inside it.

wipe-clock._look: A hard-edged line sweeps clockwise around the centre like a clock hand, revealing the new picture wedge by wedge over 1.5 s.

wipe-iris._look: A soft-edged circle opens from the centre and grows over 1.5 s until the new picture fills the frame.

wipe-soft._look: A wide, very soft band drifts left to right at a slight angle. The new picture melts in behind it over 3 s, close to a travelling crossfade.

zoom-punch._look: Old picture rushes toward the viewer (3x zoom from centre) with radial motion-blur streaks peaking at the midpoint, crossfades to the new picture, which settles back out of the zoom.
